# Attribute paths the mega menu writes, one per line: `block:path  evidence`.
# A breakpoint key is written {bp}. MegaMenuMarkupTest fails when the layouts use a path that is not listed here,
# and when a listed path is no longer used. Add or promote a path ONLY with live render evidence.
#   render:spike  rendered on the real Divi 5.15.1 in the 2026-11-03 spike (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-03-pro-megamenu-design.md)
#   recipe        the same shape is written by a shipped, render-verified recipe or a real builder export
#   pending       not yet proven by a render: make verify-pro-megamenu measures its effect and promotes it
